name: [ZOMBIES!] BloxStrike
desc:
BloxStrike is a fast-paced, competitive 5v5 shooter where strategy, aim, and teamwork decide the outcome. Battle across detailed maps in intense round-based combat. Eliminate opponents, plant or defuse the objective, and outplay the enemy team.

Earn cash each round by performing well—then spend them on a wide arsenal of weapons, utility, and gear to gain the upper hand in future rounds.

Featuring an evolving weapon skin economy, unique gameplay, and regular updates, BloxStrike delivers a next-generation FPS experience—built from the ground up for Roblox.

💥 Tactical shooter gameplay inspired by the classics
🧠 Every decision counts—buy wisely, aim true, and play smart
🎨 Deep cosmetic system with rare skins, patterns, and wear

This is just the beginning. Join now and help shape the future of BloxStrike.

scripts.title: Bloxy pearl
scripts.features:
# PEARL HUB — BLOXSTRIKE

## Aim

- **Silent Aim** — bullets redirect to enemies wherever you aim

- **Aimbot + Smoothing** — snap onto targets or slow, legit drag

- **Hold-to-Aim** — only locks while holding right mouse

- **Auto Kill** — fires on its own, no clicking

- **Wallbang** — lets you shoot through walls

- **Aim FOV + Circle** — caps how far off-crosshair it reaches

- **Prediction** — leads targets so shots land on strafers

- **Prefer Head + Team Check** — headshots, never your own team

## Weapons

- **No Recoil** — camera stops kicking when you fire

- **No Spread** — every bullet goes exactly where you point

## ESP

- **Boxes, Names, Health & Distance** — full enemy info through walls

- **Tracers & Skeleton** — lines to each enemy plus their bones

- **Head Dots & Weapon Text** — where to click, and their gun

- **Visible Check** — greys out enemies behind cover

- **Off-Screen Arrows** — points to enemies off-screen

- **Colors & Enemies Only** — team, rainbow or custom; hide allies

## World

- **Grenade & C4 ESP** — nades and the bomb through walls

- **Radar, Kill Feed & Watermark** — minimap, death log, FPS/ping

## Visuals

- **Chams** — enemies glow solid colour through walls

- **Custom Crosshair & Hitmarker** — your own, plus a hit flash

- **Target Info** — target name, HP and distance

- **Fullbright & FOV Changer** — no shadows, wider view

## Skins

- **Skin Changer** — apply any skin to any weapon

- **Wear** — float from Factory New to Battle-Scarred

- **Custom Knife** — hold any knife model, owned or not

## Movement

- **Fly** — free flight on WASD, Space and Ctrl

- **NoClip** — walk through walls and floors

- **Infinite Jump** — jump as many times as you like

- **Teleport** — instantly drop on the nearest enemy

## Misc

- **Spectate** — cycle through any player

- **Rejoin & Unload** — fresh server, or clean removal
